title: Pneumonia, lung abscess, empyema and respiratory arrest in the hospital
question: From this hospital discharge summary, assign the ICD-10-CM code for the main lung condition (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/10/2026
Discharge Date: 05/14/2026
Reason for Admission: Dysphagia and choking episode.

Hospital Course:
Pt is a 61 y/o male admitted for evaluation of acute choking episode. During stay, pt experienced a brief respiratory arrest after choking on food. Airway was cleared and bag-mask breathing restored promptly. Pt showed full recovery from the event. No further respiratory distress noted. Pt stable throughout remainder of stay. Vitals WNL. Exam showed clear lungs, CTAB. Pt tolerated diet as tolerated.

Discharge Diagnoses:
- Choking episode
- Dysphagia

Discharge Medications:
- Multivitamin 1 tab daily
- Meloxicam 15mg daily

Follow-up:
F/u with primary care provider in 1 week for swallow eval and monitoring.

Electronically signed
K. Nguyen, MD
05/14/2026
refs: ICD-10-CM Tabular: J15-J18, J69, J85-J86, R09

distractors.why: Respiratory failure is not documented; the arrest is.
